summary: Orion180 Insurance Group Inc. provides property and casualty insurance solutions in the United States. The company offers home, FLEX homeowners, DP landlord, flood, jewelry, and smart technology insurance. Orion180 Insurance Group Inc. was formerly known as Orion180 Group Inc. and changed its name to Orion180 Insurance Group Inc. in April 2026. The company was incorporated in 2018 and is based in Melbourne, Florida.
